statements.impact_statement: Only for this backend: no XsltView, XsltViewResolver or implicit view-rendering application controllers exist. Application mappings are RestController response-body endpoints. SpringWebExposureIntegrationTest guards these conditions before this VEX is applied. Vendor conditions: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/. This does not claim the dependency is patched.

Only for this backend: the application does not render view fragments or stream them over SSE. Its chatbot returns ordinary JSON. SpringWebExposureIntegrationTest guards application mappings and response types. Vendor conditions: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47890/. This does not claim the dependency is patched.

Only for this backend: WebFlux supplies WebClient for outbound requests; no WebFlux or MVC functional RouterFunction server beans are installed. SpringWebExposureIntegrationTest checks both types. The vendor requires functional WebFlux server endpoints: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47892/. This does not claim the dependency is patched.
